confidence_notes: Restaurant estimates use crowdsourced [Tainan prices](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Tainan), where the mid-range meal range is wide. The cocktail estimate uses a [local bar guide](https://lovenight-tw.com/tainan/en/blog/tainan-first-bar-guide); wine is estimated relative to beer. July accommodation prices are modeled and may vary substantially on weekends.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southern Taiwanese cities, especially Kaohsiung and Chiayi, provide the regional basis, with Tainan's domestic tourism reflected in the accommodation estimates.
